business_problem: Will Thurley, Senior Data Scientist at CKDelta, explained, “We are completely product-focused, so we don’t want to be building bespoke pieces of analysis for individual companies with different requirement levels.” To overcome these challenges, CKDelta needed a platform that could handle massive scale, simplify infrastructure, support productization and accelerate time to insights.
solution_summary: CKDelta, part of the CK Hutchison Group, turns massive volumes of telco mobility data into valuable insights for industries like retail, advertising and utilities. One standout use case is helping utility companies determine the best locations for electric vehicle (EV) charging stations. To handle and analyze more than 12 billion mobility signals daily across multiple countries, CKDelta relies on the Databricks Data + AI Platform. Databricks allows the team to streamline data ingestion, modeling and delivery in a unified environment, accelerating innovation and enabling scalable, high-impact products like ∆Power . This data-driven approach has helped CKDelta boost revenue potential by up to 20x through smarter EV charger placement.
